content.text:
* Cascoded current-mirror OTA for 20-50 pF loads.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Noiseless reference conversion and tail mirror.
XBN NB NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
RBN IBIAS NB 60000
XTAIL NT NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=95 l=1 nf=1 m=8
* Large NMOS differential pair.
XIP DN VINP NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=10
XIN DP VINN NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=10
* PMOS current mirrors with gain three; wide devices preserve input headroom.
XPD DP DP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.6 nf=1 m=2
XND DN DN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.6 nf=1 m=2
XPL PL DP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=0.6 nf=1 m=4
XPR PR DN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=0.6 nf=1 m=4
XPC_L NM PB PL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.6 nf=1 m=4
XPC_R VOUT PB PR VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.6 nf=1 m=4
* Wide-swing NMOS output current mirror.
XNL NL NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XNR NR NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XNC_L NM IBIAS NL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XNC_R VOUT IBIAS NR VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
* PMOS cascode bias: replica diode plus resistive shift.
XBS PB NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
RPB PDIO PB 30000
XPB PDIO PDIO VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.6 nf=1 m=1
* Bias bypassing and output-dominant compensation.
CNB IBIAS VSS 2p
CPB PB VDD 2p
COUT VOUT VSS 6p
.ends DUT
